footer.platform: A digital rental platform for equipment, documents, and operational services.

site.name: Mohammed V Theatre
site.description: Mohammed V Theatre offers a major cultural and technical hub in Rabat. This platform delivers an end-to-end digital experience to browse available equipment, submit rental requests, track approvals, and download official PDF documents.

serviceHighlights.title: Rental Request Management
serviceHighlights.description: Clients select available equipment and submit rental requests with full event details in a clear digital flow.

serviceHighlights.title: Official Digital Documents
serviceHighlights.description: Generate contracts, return documents, and transfer/receipt vouchers with print and verification support.

serviceHighlights.title: Request Tracking
serviceHighlights.description: Clients can track request status updates and follow each request lifecycle.

serviceHighlights.title: Clear User Experience
serviceHighlights.description: A simple interface for searching equipment, sending requests, and downloading approved documents.

rentalSteps.title: Browse Services and Products
rentalSteps.description: Start from the homepage, then explore services or the catalogue to view available equipment.

rentalSteps.title: Choose the Right Product
rentalSteps.description: Open the product page and review description, availability, and related products.

rentalSteps.title: Submit Rental Request
rentalSteps.description: After login, the client submits a request from the product page with full event details.

rentalSteps.title: Review and Documents
rentalSteps.description: After approval, the client downloads PDF files and proceeds to equipment pickup.
